scope: Final runtime-source Linux CPU comparison: 33 main-compatible calls plus three Wigner calls against the pre-simplification implementation.

baselines.main: Separately built release main at 1340631c5fe75108443b5c2defccf40e4aaaecde. Native and Python hashes were verified against forward-autodiff-regression-20261004.json before reuse.
baselines.wigner: Separately built pre-simplification forward-autodiff snapshot. Native and Python hashes were verified against forward-autodiff-simplification-20261005.json before reuse. Main cannot supply this JVP comparison because it has no forward-mode API.

method: Candidate native extension rebuilt in release mode with the standard repository flags. The Python, Rust and native fingerprints identify the measured runtime sources; logical commits and documentation changes continued during measurement, so candidate_git_head is an observation, not a claim of a clean as-run checkout.

Seven alternating paired rounds, one worker at a time, with four threads pinned to CPUs 8-11, three samples per round and at least 60 ms per sample. Setup and JAX compilation warmup are outside timed calls; each output is synchronized.
Output values must agree to relative tolerance 1e-12. Candidate/baseline ratios are the medians of paired ratios; the speed allowance is 1.05 for baseline calls of at least 1 ms and 1.10 below 1 ms.

Main cases retain all 25 previously sampled physics workflows and add eight eager/JIT JAX solve, Wigner, cluster-gradient and cross-section-gradient calls. These compare equivalent derivatives available in both revisions.
Wigner uses the original diagnostic driver for value-and-JVP, derivative-only JVP and reverse gradient, against the same verified pre-simplification built package.

No concurrent native builds, full test suites or other timing runs. Short JAX compilation and callback-count diagnostics ran on CPU 12, outside the benchmark affinity of CPUs 8-11. An unrelated background indexing service remained active; affinity and alternating pairs reduce but do not eliminate background-load noise. Every paired sample and range is retained.
This is a bounded Linux CPU regression check, not the historical full qualification grid, a cross-platform result, or a complete GPU/memory evaluation.

# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.12"
# dependencies = []
# ///
"""Compare main-compatible paths with the repository's paired timing driver.

Set TREAMS_BENCHMARK_ROOT to the candidate checkout. Adds eager JAX paths omitted
from the stock comparison. JVP is intentionally absent: main has no JVP API.
"""
import importlib
import json
import os
import sys
from functools import partial
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(os.environ["TREAMS_BENCHMARK_ROOT"])
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import compare_builds as comparison

comparison.__file__ = __file__

for family in ("solve", "wignerd"):
    for mode in ("eager-value", "eager-grad", "jit-grad"):
        @comparison.call(f"final-jax-{family}-{mode}", framework="jax")
        def setup(tr, family=family, mode=mode):
            import jax
            import jax.numpy as jnp

            jax.config.update("jax_enable_x64", True)
            diff = importlib.import_module("treams_rs.diff")
            tj = importlib.import_module("treams_rs.jax")
            if family == "solve":
                a = jnp.array([[2.0, 0.2], [0.1, 3.0]])
                x = jnp.array([[1.0], [2.0]])
                wrapped = tj.wrap(diff.solve, a, x)
                function = lambda x: wrapped(a, x)
            else:
                x = jnp.linspace(0.7, 1.1, 64)
                theta, psi = jnp.asarray(0.6), jnp.asarray(0.3)
                wrapped = tj.wrap(partial(diff.wignerd, 2, 1, -1), x, theta, psi)
                function = lambda x: wrapped(x, theta, psi)
            if mode == "eager-value":
                run = function
            else:
                run = jax.grad(lambda z: jnp.real(function(z)).sum())
                if mode == "jit-grad":
                    run = jax.jit(run)
            return lambda: jax.block_until_ready(run(x))

for name in ("cluster-solve-n4", "cross-sections-l3"):
    objective, x0 = comparison.FRAMEWORK_OBJECTIVES[name]
    @comparison.call(f"final-jax-eager-grad-{name}", framework="jax")
    def setup_eager(tr, objective=objective, x0=x0):
        import jax
        import jax.numpy as jnp

        jax.config.update("jax_enable_x64", True)
        tj = importlib.import_module("treams_rs.jax")
        run = jax.value_and_grad(partial(objective, tj))
        x = jnp.asarray(x0)
        return lambda: jax.block_until_ready(run(x))

_run_round = comparison.run_round
_rounds = []
def record_round(trees, names, arguments, index):
    result = _run_round(trees, names, arguments, index)
    _rounds.append(result)
    checkpoint = os.environ.get("TREAMS_BENCHMARK_CHECKPOINT")
    if checkpoint:
        with Path(checkpoint).open("a") as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(result) + "\n")
    if index >= 2:
        calls = comparison.summarize(_rounds, names, arguments.rtol)
        failed = {name: entry["ratio"] for name, entry in calls.items() if not entry["passed"]}
        print(f"interim failed ratios after {index + 1} rounds: {failed}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    return result
comparison.run_round = record_round

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(comparison.main())
